SUBARU-PRIDE_FACTOR_SPIKE.title: Pride Factor
SUBARU-PRIDE_FACTOR_SPIKE.description: At the start of combat, gain 3 [gold]Pride[/gold]. When your HP would reach 0, trigger [gold]Return by Death[/gold]: for each Return by Death this combat, gain +2 [gold]Strength[/gold] and +1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] (Elite combats +3/+2, Boss combats +4/+3).
SUBARU-PRIDE_FACTOR_PLUS.title: Pride Factor+
SUBARU-PRIDE_FACTOR_PLUS.description: At the start of combat, gain 4 [gold]Pride[/gold]. When your HP would reach 0, trigger [gold]Return by Death[/gold]: for each Return by Death this combat, gain +2 [gold]Strength[/gold] and +1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] (Elite combats +3/+2, Boss combats +4/+3).
SUBARU-DRAGON_SWORD.title: Dragon Sword Reid
SUBARU-DRAGON_SWORD.description: At the start of each turn, gain 2 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
SUBARU-DRAGON_SWORD.flavor: A holy blade passed down through the Astrea family.
SUBARU-YANG_SWORD.title: Yang Sword Vollachia
SUBARU-YANG_SWORD.description: At the start of your 3rd turn in each combat, deal 15 damage to ALL enemies.
SUBARU-YANG_SWORD.flavor: Symbol of the Imperial royal family. It burns everything away.
SUBARU-CURSED_SWORD_MURASAME.title: Cursed Sword Murasame
SUBARU-CURSED_SWORD_MURASAME.description: Whenever an enemy dies, deal 10 damage to the other enemies. [gold]Enemies lose their revives.[/gold]
SUBARU-DREAM_SWORD.title: Dream Sword: True Dream
SUBARU-DREAM_SWORD.description: At the start of the first turn of each combat, choose any number of cards in your hand to [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. For each card Exhausted this way, deal 10 damage to ALL enemies. In Elite combats this damage is doubled, in Boss combats tripled. You may Exhaust none.
SUBARU-DREAM_SWORD.flavor: Unleash your desires and your dreams!
SUBARU-TALKING_MIRROR.title: Talking Mirror
SUBARU-TALKING_MIRROR.description: The first [gold]Skill[/gold] you play each combat is played 1 additional time.
SUBARU-MIASMA_STONE.title: Miasma Stone
SUBARU-MIASMA_STONE.description: At the end of each turn, absorb 3 stacks of [gold]Witch's Scent[/gold].
SUBARU-MIASMA_STONE.flavor: A deep black stone. It looks dangerous.
SUBARU-WARDING_CRYSTAL.title: Warding Crystal
SUBARU-WARDING_CRYSTAL.description: At the start of combat, apply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] to all enemies.
SUBARU-WARDING_CRYSTAL.flavor: A crystal that neutralizes or weakens mana.
SUBARU-BLACK_WATER.title: Black Water
SUBARU-BLACK_WATER.description: At the start of each turn, apply 3 [gold]Poison[/gold] to all enemies.
SUBARU-BLACK_WATER.flavor: The venom that sank to the bottom of the lake 100 years ago, when the demon beast [gold]Black Serpent[/gold] attacked the Elior Forest. Once it solidified it began to behave like a living thing - it melts and absorbs whatever it touches, and it is possessed of some intelligence.
SUBARU-DRAGON_ORB.title: Dragon Orb
SUBARU-DRAGON_ORB.description: Starting from turn 3, gain 1 additional [gold]Energy[/gold] each turn.
SUBARU-DRAGON_ORB.flavor: When held by a worthy bearer, the gem at its center shines.
SUBARU-BEATRICE_GUARD.title: Beatrice's Ward
SUBARU-BEATRICE_GUARD.description: Whenever you [gold]Return by Death[/gold], immediately gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to your [gold]Witch's Scent[/gold] divided by 10 (rounded down).
SUBARU-MY_STAR.title: My Star
SUBARU-MY_STAR.description: Whenever you [gold]Return by Death[/gold], heal 6 HP.
SUBARU-MY_STAR.flavor: May the starlight be with you.
SUBARU-THORN_CROWN.title: Thorn Crown
SUBARU-THORN_CROWN.description: At the start of combat, gain 3 [gold]Thorns[/gold]. Each time you [gold]Return by Death[/gold], gain 2 more [gold]Thorns[/gold]. At the end of your turn, deal damage equal to your [gold]Thorns[/gold] to all enemies.
SUBARU-THORN_CROWN.flavor: No one knows what price was paid behind the crown.
SUBARU-EVOLUTION.title: Evolution
SUBARU-EVOLUTION.description: At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to 10% of your [gold]Max HP[/gold].
SUBARU-EMPERORS_DAGGER.title: Emperor's Dagger
SUBARU-EMPERORS_DAGGER.description: At the start of each turn, gain 2 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
